title: rhobound-cli.report/v2
description: The report of `rhobound predict --fit F (--changes C | --patch P) --json` (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.1-4.8), written by the pure engine. Additive over report v1: every v1 key keeps its name, type and meaning, and `capture` is the capture name stored in the fit. The v1 projection (`--report v1`) removes every key that report.v1's base does not define, at the top level and in each service row, and sets `version` to rhobound-cli.report/v1. The report holds no policy: thresholds, verdicts and the policy's band fractions are the gate's (gate.v1).

fit_window.description: the fit's window; the gate measures the fit's age from its end (rule 3, fit_stale)

change_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical change set (change.v1) that was applied

record_digests.description: the A/B records (and, later, verified profiles) whose numbers entered as measured items

evaluated_at.description: the engine evaluates at the fit's window, or a what-if load_scale (predict --fit F --load-scale S): the services' rates, utilizations, waits and model means are then at it, their error_pct stays the model at the fit's load against the traces; the gate decides busiest-window questions

value.description: a point is lo == hi; a measured item is its value +-2 standard errors

items.description: the change items as applied, in the change set's order; `labels[].item` indexes this list

corners.description: solves made for the ranges' corners

before_at_fit_load_ms.description: what-if only (load.evaluated_at what_if): the entry's model mean before the change at the fit's load (load_scale 1); before_ms, after_ms and change_ms are at load.load_scale

load_level_ms.description: what-if only: before_ms less before_at_fit_load_ms, what the load alone moves the entry's mean; change_ms never holds it (it is after minus before, both at load.load_scale)

model_band_ms.description: max(change_frac x max|change|, latency_frac x before_ms) at the default fractions (model_band): the band at the larger end, for display

band_ms.description: change_ms with each end widened by the model band at that end's own change (lo - band(lo), hi + band(hi)), then by each biased construct on its side

direction.description: the side the documented error lies on: over-predicted, under-predicted, or both

biased.description: constructs with a documented directional error on the path to this entry (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.5, item 3)

services.description: the services whose worker count is a lower bound (workers_are_a_lower_bound) that some corner raises (utilization after it above the one before), in the rows' order

change_ms.description: over the corners, the least of the entry's change and its change with each such service the corner raises given more workers: unbounded (a pure delay: its service time kept, no queue) and at each count of a ladder above its bound (bound+1..+4, 2x, 4x, 8x), since a raise's departure smoothing makes the change non-monotone in the workers; never above change_ms at either end

band_ms.description: this change_ms widened as the entry's band_ms widens its change_ms

workers_unbounded.description: only when the change raises a service whose worker count is a lower bound and change_ms is not null: the entry's change with their queueing at its least, which the gate reads to keep a block that does not rest on them (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.3, rule 10)

entries.description: one row per entry service; the ranges are null when a corner saturates a service (no finite mean)

label.const: simulated p90 floor; real software untested

model_band.description: the defaults used for display: 0.163 and 0.0227, worst case 0.355 and 0.0752 (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.5)

utilization_after.description: over the corners; null without a change. At or above 1 the service saturates

change_range_ms.description: the change of model_ms over the corners; absent when a corner leaves the service unsolved
